label: M8 general leg follower (post-hoc, exploratory). Written before any main run.

width.rule: smallest width within 5 pp of panel finishes of the next wider width and of the P2 specialists on every bin (10M, seeds 100-102, final checkpoints)
width.evidence: runs/ese3990/M8/width_rule.json: panel finish fraction 2x128 0.27 (per seed 0, 23, 9), 2x256 0.53 (19, 22, 23), 2x512 0.17 (20, 0, 0), 3x256 0.03 (0, 0, 3); specialists on their own bins: up+close 0.17, reach 0.29, broad+run 0.75 vs the 2x256 generalist 0.27/0.46/0.83 on the same legs. Only 2x256 passes. The 5% finish-time leg is not applied: mean finish time is over different finished subsets (2x512 has one learning seed). Wider and deeper nets fail by not lifting off on 2/3 seeds, not by a capacity ceiling; P3 cut.

curriculum.choice: none: every training width {open, 30, 15, 10} from the start
curriculum.evidence: the planned open-water-first curriculum (M7 recipe) left all 21 pilot runs at stage 0 with 0-3/40 at 4-6M while the no-curriculum 2x256 arm reached 14-24/40 (handoff log 05:39)

ppo.defaults: fixed scaling (MEAN8/STD8, clip 10), target head, 0.5 s decisions (repeat 10), ent 0.001, log_std0 -0.5, lr 3e-4, 16 envs x 256 policy steps, 4 epochs, minibatch 512, lambda 0.95

sac.defaults: M6 configuration: target head, repeat 10, replay 400k, UTD 1, warmup 5000, target entropy -2, alpha0 0.2, batch 256, tau 0.005; no curriculum

tuning: post-hoc learner-side iterations, if a main arm misses the session goal, are run on pilot seeds 100-102 first and then on seeds 0-9 as new named arms; main runs are retained unchanged
selection: the checkpoint with most finishes on the 40-leg stratified panel; ties go to the later checkpoint
general: >= 90% of validation single legs overall and >= 70% (3/4) in every bearing x corridor cell (5 x 3)
bar: >= 8/10 PPO seeds general (plan); the session goal is M7 consistency: PPO >= 9/10 and SAC >= 4/10 seeds passing
